items.title: Move the lint toolchain off the end-of-support ESLint 9 line
executionLog: npm reported eslint@9.39.5 deprecated (no longer supported). Moved to eslint 10.11.0, @eslint/js 10.0.1, eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1, globals 17.12.0; dropped eslint-plugin-react (peer range stops at ESLint 9; its only rule, jsx-uses-vars, is native in ESLint 10). Enforced ruleset is unchanged: rules-of-hooks + exhaustive-deps. lint:strict 0 warnings; 1,671/1,671 tests; build green.
items.why: The ruler the repo gates on had reached end of support. Dependabot's ESLint 10 PR could not merge cleanly because the react plugin peer range and the hooks plugin's new Compiler-rule preset both moved.
items.recipe: Trust-gate the four packages, remove eslint-plugin-react, install the ESLint 10 stack, replace the recommended preset spread with the two classic rules so the enforced ruleset does not silently widen to 177 findings, and re-run lint:strict, build and the suite.

premises.claim: The lint stack is declared on the ESLint 10 line

L2.recipe: Move the full stack, drop the incompatible react plugin, pin the classic hooks rules.

L3.recipe: Also fix the 177 React Compiler findings and adopt the recommended preset.

items.title: Apply in-range dependency updates that have cleared the release-age cooldown
executionLog: react/react-dom 19.3.0, vite 7.3.6, @sentry/react 8.55.2, @vitejs/plugin-react 5.2.0, eslint-plugin-react-refresh 0.5.7 applied after the package-trust gate returned APPROVE. sharp 0.35.5 (2 days old) and @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.2 (4 days old) deliberately held back for the cooldown. Bundle sizes unchanged.
items.why: Five packages sat behind their in-range wanted version. Two others are too new to trust yet, so the change is partial by design and says so.
items.recipe: npm update the cooled-down set only, then lint:strict, build, full suite and npm audit.

L2.recipe: Trust-gate and cooldown-filter, then update and verify.

L3.recipe: Add a scheduled cooldown-aware bump receipt.

items.title: Close pull requests whose work has already shipped on main
executionLog: PR #163 (PERK_FACTS) superseded by S178's src/config/perkFacts.js covering all 27 ordinary perks. PRs #153 (eslint 10.10) and #156 (globals 17.12) superseded by this session's exact versions.
items.why: An open PR that main has already outgrown reads as unfinished work and invites a stale merge over verified code.
items.recipe: Verify each premise against main, close with an explanatory comment naming the superseding change.

premises.claim: The shared perk facts authority exists on main

L2.recipe: Verify supersession, then close with evidence.
